concerns.text: T012c implements a 'try RefSeq, fallback to Phytozome' logic. FR-001 requires downloading from 'NCBI RefSeq or Phytozome' as valid primary sources. The task's fallback strategy silently weakens the requirement to treat Phytozome as a primary source, potentially violating the spec's intent to utilize both sources equally if RefSeq is unavailable for a species.

FR-006 and SC-001 mandate comparing model R² against a Phylogenetic Permutation baseline to ensure statistical significance (p < 0.05). T027a (perform_pvalue_test) is unimplemented. Without this task, the project cannot satisfy the 'Verified Accuracy' success criterion or the constitutional requirement to validate against overfitting.

FR-010 mandates PGLS as the PRIMARY model. T024b (report_primary_pgls_results) is unimplemented. The spec requires the final report to include PGLS results (Constitution Principle IV: Single Source of Truth). Without this task, the primary metric is not extracted or persisted, violating the requirement to generate a verifiable primary result.

FR-007 and SC-002 require a sensitivity analysis sweeping thresholds and verifying R² variation ≤ 0.05. T030a (retrain_with_thresholds) and T031 (calculate_variation) are unimplemented. The task list fails to provide the mechanism to verify the robustness criterion, effectively dropping the acceptance criteria for US-3.

FR-005 requires 5-fold CV or LOO based on N. The tasks T023a/T023b are separate but lack an explicit orchestration task to automatically select the method based on N (as described in the task description 'if N >= 20...'). This relies on implicit logic or manual intervention, risking the violation of the cross-validation requirement if the wrong method is run.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and Principle V (Versioning) require checksumming raw data and recording hashes in the state file. T007 and T007b are unimplemented. Without these, the project cannot guarantee data integrity or versioning discipline, violating the non-negotiable constitution requirements.

Constitution Principle VII requires a label-permutation baseline. T026 implements the permutation, but T027a (p-value test) is missing. The baseline generation alone does not satisfy the requirement to 'validate' the signal; the statistical comparison is the missing link that makes the baseline useful.
